canonical_statement: For a smooth real-valued function near a nondegenerate critical point of a finite-dimensional real smooth manifold without boundary, there are centered smooth local coordinates in which the function is exactly its critical value plus a diagonal quadratic form with index many negative squares.
domain_and_universes: universe u; n : Nat; M : Type u; a boundaryless smooth manifold modeled on Fin n -> Real
hypotheses: the coordinate representative is ContDiffOn Real top on base.target
its Frechet derivative at zero is zero
its coordinate Hessian at zero is injective
conclusion: There exist index <= n and centered smooth local coordinates normal such that for every x in normal.target, f (normal.invFun x) = f p minus the squares in coordinates i < index plus the remaining squares.

killed: weakened neighborhood equality to equality only at zero

degenerate_cases: Dimension zero is included. The inequalities index <= n include local minima (index zero) and local maxima (index n). The local-coordinate target is an open neighborhood containing zero, so equality is not merely pointwise at the critical point.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; the statement itself uses no classical choice
computation_profile: Noncomputable coordinate Hessian through fderiv; no computation is proof evidence
status_boundary: Statement-only evidence: the exact target and mutations elaborate with the pinned environment. No Morse lemma proof, anchor audit, H0, M0, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
